name: Harrods Limited
description: At Harrods, we believe nothing is impossible. We drive ourselves and inspire others to always push for more. This passion to exceed is what sets us apart. We believe in doing things properly, with great care and attention to the finest detail. We recognise we can achieve much more working together than alone and strive to create a supportive environment where collaboration is encouraged and learning is freely shared. We are proud to be a place where standing out means being yourself.

name: Coventry Building Society
description:
Coventry Building Society is one of the top ten mortgage and savings providers in the UK. We are the UK's second largest building society with more than £50bn in assets and around 2 million members across the country. We have been recognised as one of the best places to work in the UK according to the 2022 UK Great Places to Work survey.

We help borrowers at all stages of life to buy their own home. And we offer a range of competitive savings accounts. Our incredible customer service makes us special, saving our members time and effort. Call waiting times are typically measured in seconds, not minutes, and our network of branches from Sheffield to Somerset provide brilliant face to face service. 

We care about making life better, not only for our members and our employees, but also the communities in which they live and work. We want to have a positive impact on everyone - our customers, colleagues, communities and the planet we all share.

name: PZ Cussons Plc
description:
Want to be part of the success story of some of the world’s leading household names? PZ Cussons is parent to some brilliant brands. Join us and you could be helping to enhance the lives of consumers around the world.

Talent, imagination and drive will take you places at PZ Cussons. Join our global family to see what’s possible.  We believe work should be fulfilling and talent should be recognised, so if you have a CAN DO attitude, aptitude and ambition, there’s no end to the opportunities available. You’ll work on the best brands, in interesting markets and with great people who truly excel in their field

We have teams based in the UK, Greece, Poland, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Thailand, Indonesia and Australia.  Our brands include Imperial Leather, Original Source, Carex, Mum and Me, Mamador cooking oil, five:am breakfast food; Rafferty’s Garden baby food, St Tropez, Sanctuary Spa, Charles Worthington, Fudge hair, Coolworld Electricals and many many more… and you could be part of it…

name: HC-One Ltd.
description: HC-One specialises in Dementia, Nursing, Residential and Specialist care with homes throughout the UK. Each of our Residents and their relatives can trust that the care they will receive will be delivered with kindness, thoughtfulness and respect, in a safe, warm, comfortable and welcoming environment.

Shoosmiths
description:
Our client list speaks volumes for the quality of our lawyers and the experience they provide. From Hewlett-Packard to Krispy Kreme and property developers to some of the UK's largest banks, we work with a growing number of the FTSE 250 and some of the world's most exciting and ambitious growth businesses. Shoosmiths is a major UK law firm with a network of offices working together as one national team.

There's no secret to our growth over recent years to become a £87m turnover firm. Clients love working with Shoosmiths people because of the way we work and the results we consistently deliver for them. You don't have to take our word for it, many of our clients are happy to talk on our behalf - we've never been ones for banging our own drum.

name: Shoosmiths LLP
description:
Solutions for the challenges in life

Life presents many challenges.   Our aim is to ensure that using the law to protect what matters to you most doesn't have to be another one. 

Making the law work for you

We're the private client arm of Shoosmiths, a major national law firm that has been advising clients for over 160 years. We call the service that we provide Access Legal because that's precisely what we aim to do: give you easy access to the law through friendly, approachable people who know how to make the complex simple.
